name: ivac-automation-management
description: IVAC Automation License Backend & Admin Portal Monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix ivac-license-backend" "npm run dev --prefix ivac-license-admin"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix ivac-license-backend && npm run build --prefix ivac-license-admin
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix ivac-license-backend && npm install --prefix ivac-license-admin
